nonRewriteRule: This file is a versioned selection addendum. It does not rewrite study-plan.json. Selection precedes encoding and is independent of expected validator outcomes.

baselineCorpusAtAddendum.notes: PR #19 hard-eligibility case is included in the baseline count after merge to main. At least four additional encoded cases are still required to reach the study-plan minimum of eight.

encodedAfterAddendum.notes: Five selection-addendum candidates were encoded from public sources only. Case-count gate (8–12) is met. ready-for-final-review remains blocked on double annotation.

selectionRule: Prefer candidates that add distinct evidence structures over clones of the same award pattern. Encode only source-bounded public ENS/SPP facts. Do not invent AI-assisted historical involvement.

candidates.inclusionRationale: Public SPP3 cohort recommendation names Goldsky for a $450,000 indexing award as a first-time SPP provider with Option B scope confirmation and milestone structure. Distinct from Namespace: new-to-SPP provider and standalone indexing mandate rather than subname infrastructure.
candidates.exclusionBoundary: Does not reconstruct other cohort members, private individual scores beyond published means, KYC/Award Notice contents, or application bytes if retrieval fails. Does not invent AI-evaluator involvement.

candidates.inclusionRationale: SPP2 used delegate ranked-choice selection under EP 6.10 with Snapshot/spp.vote quorum-visible mechanics. JustaName is publicly documented as a new SPP2-funded provider ($300,000 one-year stream), supplying a prior-season award structure distinct from SPP3 committee recommendation.
candidates.exclusionBoundary: Does not rescore JustaName, reconstruct every delegate ballot, or treat unofficial stream-tracking repositories as cryptographic proof. Application and vote mirrors remain reference-only unless bytes are preserved.
candidates.encodingNote: committee-quorum was an intended stratum at selection time; the encoded case does not claim that stratum because no source-bounded quorum percentage was bound in the reconstruction. Funding is taken from public EP6.13.

candidates.inclusionRationale: EP 6.5 is an explicit published amendment changing SPP2 voting/allocation mechanics (rank-budget / NONE BELOW) with a dated facilitation-plan change notice. Exercises policy-change reconstruction without cloning an award outcome already covered by the Agora rejection case.
candidates.exclusionBoundary: Represents the amendment decision/process change, not every subsequent SPP2 award. Does not treat the Agora no-award outcome as this case's unit of analysis.

candidates.inclusionRationale: Public SPP2 Q4 2025 quarterly report from funded provider Unruggable documents post-award delivery/milestone reporting. Distinct structure from initial award encoding: accountability after funding rather than selection.
candidates.exclusionBoundary: Does not convert provider self-report into independent verification of every claimed deliverable, invent stream-pause decisions, or treat AI-agent research mentions as historical AI-assisted evaluation of applicants.

candidates.inclusionRationale: EP 7.1 is a public one-time amendment authorizing a scoped Marketplace RFP from uncommitted SPP3 budget after EthID withdrawal, with milestone-gated award design. At selection time the RFP process is publicly incomplete (submissions/review reported; final award not treated as settled here), which exercises incomplete-public-record outside a standard cohort award.
candidates.exclusionBoundary: Does not invent a final marketplace awardee, award amount, or interview outcomes. Does not reopen EthID withdrawal as this case's primary unit of analysis (already encoded separately).

candidates.inclusionRationale: Fluidkey is the smallest published SPP3 award ($340,000) with an explicit public-goods versus commercial-product separation in the cohort rationale. Adds a different award structure within the same season without cloning Namespace.
candidates.exclusionBoundary: Does not reconstruct private scoring sheets, KYC, or Award Notice text. Application URI remains reference-only unless bytes are lawfully preserved.
candidates.holdReason: Case-count minimum already met after five preferred encodings; Fluidkey remains available if further structural diversity or public-private-separation stress is needed before the 12-case ceiling.

researchedButNotSelectedAsSeparateCase.rationale: The published SPP3 cohort recommendation discloses one recusal (sovereignsignal.eth on Namespace). That event is already represented in the encoded Namespace case. No second, distinct public recusal event was verified for a separate case without inventing facts.

Public Unruggable delivery reports discuss AI-agent identity research as funded work product. That is not authoritative evidence that historical SPP applicant evaluation used material AI assistance. Conditional stratum remains not evidenced; Phase II stays synthetic/fixture-based.

researchedButNotSelectedAsSeparateCase.topic: Unruggable or Blockful SPP3/SPP2 duplicate awards
researchedButNotSelectedAsSeparateCase.rationale: Additional award clones are available from public sources but would add less structural diversity than the preferred encoded set. May be encoded later only if needed before the 12-case ceiling.

remainingWork: Human second annotations remain required for the double-annotation gate (minimum 25% of counted cases; currently 0/9).
Optional: encode Fluidkey if additional public-private-separation stress is desired before the maximum of 12.
Do not mark study ready-for-final-review until double-annotation (and any remaining research dispositions) actually satisfy machine gates.
Do not invent an AI-assisted historical case.
limitations: Candidate inclusion is source-bounded and pre-encoding; it does not claim that every intended stratum will be reconstructable once annotated.
Some application IPFS URIs may be retrieval-failed at encoding time; unknowns remain admissible.
This addendum is not a preregistration rewrite and must not be described as part of the original study-plan declaration.
JustaName intended committee-quorum at selection time; encoded strata omit that claim absent a bound quorum figure.
nonClaims: Selection does not establish annotation correctness, source truth, fairness, merit, or institutional legitimacy.
Listing a candidate does not count it as an empirical corpus case until the corpus contract passes.
Absence of an AI-assisted case here does not prove no ENS process ever used AI; it only records that this corpus has not evidenced that conditional stratum.
Meeting the 8–12 case-count band does not by itself make the study ready-for-final-review.
